description.value: The study investigated relationships between brain shrinkage and decision-making impairments in alcohol-dependent individuals early in abstinence using voxel-based morphometry.
Thirty alcohol-dependent patients early in abstinence were studied in inpatient treatment and compared with healthy controls; neuroimaging controls were drawn from a database.

value: Higher scores on the IGT (i.e. better decision-making) were positively correlated with higher gray matter volume in the vmPFC, the dorsal portion of the anterior cingulate cortex and the right hippocampal formation, after controlling for number of withdrawals and duration of alcoholism. These brain regions were correlated with decision-making deficits even after removal of the potential effect of confounding variables.

spans.text: Conducted in the alcoholic group only, an exploratory regression analysis between the decision-making measure and the voxels with decreased GM volume, using the number of withdrawals and the duration of alcoholism as covariates, revealed that higher scores on the IGT (i.e. better decision-making) were [positively] correlated with higher gray matter volume in the vmPFC (with the peak in the left gyrus rectus extending to the right gyrus rectus and the perigenual portion of the anterior cingulate cortex), the dorsal portion of the anterior cingulate cortex (i.e., the midcingulate gyrus) and the right hippocampal formation ( and ).

Participants selected cards from four decks for 100 selections, attempting to maximize gains and minimize losses. Decks A and B were disadvantageous and decks C and D were advantageous.

instructions.value: Participants were instructed to lose as little money as possible and win as much as possible by selecting one card at a time from any of four decks; they could switch decks freely.

value: Four card decks labeled A, B, C, and D

Decision-making measure: number of cards from advantageous decks (C + D) minus number of cards from disadvantageous decks (A + B), measured after 100 selections and across five blocks of 20 selections
